name: Takamura Yui
source:
A TSF pilot in the Japanese Royal Guard, which serves to protect the Shogun’s family. She is a member of the Takamura Clan, one of the high-ranking Fudai families, and constantly strives to live up to the family name, and to the reputation of her father, a legendary soldier. Because of this, she has a strict and uncompromising personality and is very hard on herself. She is sent to Yukon Base as the Japanese lead developer of the XFJ Project. As a Japanese, she finds Yuuya’s criticism of Japan frustrating, and makes no attempt to hide her irritation. The two of them clash constantly.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
